comment: The packet giving world (the owner's word of 2026-10-03, 09:46 Israel, 'a new emitter detector also needs to enter'; the mathematician's 224 (1), #1572 comment 5966081562, and 229, 5966424405; the advisor's seconds, 5966129376 with #1563 comment 5966129628, his derivation 5966387795 step 5 and his precisions 5966338551 step 5; two hands): the open board's giving as a packet along a drawn axis, read in the engine. On the Zeno atom's universe (examples/events/zeno/zeno_atom.json, T = 32,768, the light `pulse` the massless holder of the sign) an open board of `width` Nodes across on y and z and long on x, the one board of this lay the machine runs in minutes: the giver, the resonance world's atom standing in its upper part e, its transition g to e by `pulse` at the resonance [2, 3] and its giving e to g at the lifetime 48 with the window 48 (drawn with certainty at the interval 48), declares the packet's width 4, the one new number; the loader finds the board open (three axes above one Node) and holds the packet along x alone (the train of L slices from the body's Node fits neither y nor z), so the giver draws between +x and -x with its own generator. The lay: the exact root S = isqrt((T den div 2)^2 div (den^2 - num^2)), the envelope in the energy form (a_t = isqrt((R_t div tau) div w^2), R_(t+1) = R_t - w^2 a_t^2, the lay ending where a_t falls below 1), the wave number along x from the band's line with the transverse mode, cos k_x = 3 cos Omega - 2 cos(pi / (w + 1)), the top-hat of w across; the body at the centre of x with L + 1 Nodes on either side. The detector: a region of the band's top, the 4 x 4 slice across x at the derived reach from the body on the +x side, z_reach = (pi w / lambda) sqrt(S / L), its window the run (one draw at the end). The far reading: the light's level at the Node on the axis half way to the detector over the window of the passage, cos Omega as SUM_t n_t (n_(t+1) + n_(t-1)) / (2 SUM_t n_t^2), a GameBoard reading labelled so. The blind in expectation.json, written by build_world.py from this design before any lay and never touched after; the reading in blind_and_reading.md, a miss a finding by name.

lay.total_formula: S = isqrt((T den div 2)^2 div (den^2 - num^2))
lay.length_formula: the envelope in the energy form from tau and T, a_t = isqrt((R_t div tau) div w^2), R_(t+1) = R_t - w^2 a_t^2, ending where a_t falls below 1

count.reading: the detector's credit lines (DETECTOR) in its own unit, the band's top, over its window, the run, the packet's passage
count.status: one quantum one click by the count's line (the advisor's clause (iii)); read over the seeds whose drawn direction meets the detector

cos_omega.gate: |cos Omega_read - num / den| <= 2 / A_far with A_far = max |n_t| over the window at the reading Node (the mathematician's 220, the advisor's second); a GameBoard reading

direction.reading: the fraction of seeds whose lay lines extend from the body toward the detector (the equivalent directions the board holds, each at the giving's weight)
direction.gate: within sqrt(N p (1 - p)) of N p over the seeds

status: the two hands' lines (224, 229, the advisor's seconds); fence: clicks for the count, a GameBoard reading for the cosine, the lay lines for the direction
